verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents many API features, including tool use, batches, structured outputs, Skills and Managed Agents, through short feature descriptions. Nothing describes an official cookbook, tutorial set, or worked end-to-end example a developer could adapt. Pre-built Agent Skills and the Managed Agents harness are product features, not worked examples, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, official cookbooks or worked examples show real end-to-end tasks — not just single-call snippets — that I can adapt
